http://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/85440/mezikes-sotm-online-gaming-aid is where the spreadsheet is located.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Apostate has a fairly swingy difficulty. It mostly depends on the number of heroes you have and if he draws Profane Summons. With less heroes the damage is so minimal that heroes with damage reduction barely bat an eye to him. Plus Profane Summons only brings out two relics, which isn't so hard to handle at all. But once you get to five players he deals so much damage and thus profane summons just cause so much trouble.

 

You'll only be safe for a little while, villians always come back. And it's always when you least expect it.

posts.name: celette482
posts.cooked:
They do have a certain cockroach-like tendency to survive. Or maybe like mold: you think you got it all and as soon as you turn your back, there's a fresh patch

 

I like deck management for Apostate. Wraith (bonus points if you utility belt- stunbolt him) or Dark visionary. He definitely has cards that are good and cards that are not great. I had this one amazing chain of a few into the stratospheres and then the temporal grenade on an Apocalypse card that essentially neutered his deck. That was the last time I beat him.
